lore: A short book for everyone who prefers to work in big strokes.
use: The Simple Hammers Guide explains the sledgehammers, carving, crushing and in-world upgrades. Craft it shapeless from a book and an iron ingot.
secret: Its pages open in your language and nothing is consumed.

lore: {name}: a pickaxe that never learned to stop at one block.
use: Mines like a pickaxe of its tier, but takes the 3x3 area in front of you along; sneak to mine only the aimed block. Sneak and hold use on a block to knock an octet off it.
secret: With the upgrade material in the off hand, holding use on an upgradable block strikes it up to the next tier, contents included.
